title: One shift step on a paired configuration
statement: For any bit strings $M,w,o$, either a shift step leaves the pairing of $M$ with the pairing of $w$ and $o$ unchanged, or there are bit strings $w',o'$ such that the shifted configuration is the pairing of $M$ with the pairing of $w'$ and $o'$, and $|w'|+|o'|\le |w|+|o|+2|M|+8$.
